# dsh-chat-plugin
简体中文 | English
An independent plugin that opens the official DeepSeek Chat website in the main panel of DeepSeek Ha
rness Desktop. Open Chat from the left sidebar or the icon in the Agent Session header's right-side
utilities. Switching between Chat and Agent does not reload the Chat page. The header icon appears w
hen a nonblank Agent Session is open, including while the left sidebar is collapsed.
This project is community maintained and is not an official DeepSeek release.
## Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` or later in the `0.2.x` series, with the `dshDesktop.browser

` bridge.
- Node.js 22.19 or later to build from source. The committed `lib/` files let a local dire
ctory or Git install load without a build step.
## Install
Fully quit DeepSeek Harness Desktop, then install the plugin from GitHub:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Reopen Desktop and select **DeepSeek Chat** in the sidebar. For a local checkout, select the reposit
ory root (containing `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml`) in Desktop's plugin manager, or run `dsh
plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-chat-plugin`. If an earlier local build of this
plugin is installed, remove it before installing from GitHub.
The committed `lib/index.js` and `lib/client.js` make installation possible without an install-time
build. Pin a Git commit when you need a reproducible installation.
## Behavior and limits
- The embedded page is the official Chat website. SMS login happens on that page; the plugin does no

t handle passwords, codes, cookies, or chat text.
- On the Chat website, right-clicking selected tex

t offers a small **Copy** menu; right clicks without a selection keep their existing behavior.
- The
plugin starts loading the Chat website in a hidden view when Desktop starts, so opening Chat later

can reuse the ready page. A slow network can still delay an immediate first open.
- The same operati
ng-system user's Harness workspaces share the Chat browser partition while the Desktop process is ru

nning. The retained view preserves login and unsent drafts when switching Chat ↔ Agent.
- If loading
stalls, the panel offers Retry and reports a timeout after 30 seconds. Reload refreshes the current
page; Return to Chat restores the previous Chat address after navigation to another website. The pa

ge stays visible with a small loading status during either action.
- The official Desktop Browser br
idge uses an in-memory partition. After **all** Desktop processes exit, website storage is cleared a
nd Chat requires a new login. **More actions → Local login data…** explains that exit procedure; it

does not revoke server-side sessions.
- When a new Chat browser partition first opens, the plugin in
itializes the website language from the active Harness language (which follows the OS when no prefer
ence was selected). A specific language selected inside Chat lasts until Desktop fully exits. Select
ing **System** is remapped to the Harness language when a new Chat guest opens. Changing the Harness

language while Chat is open does not reload Chat or discard a draft.
- You can still change the web
site language under **Settings → General → Language**. The plugin reads and writes only the website'
s language preference; if DeepSeek changes that internal storage format, this initialization may nee

d an update.
- Other website login methods and update transitions have not been verified.
## Develop
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`npm run check` type-checks the plugin, runs focused behavior tests, builds `lib/`, and checks the i
nstallable bundle. Rebuild and commit the two `lib/` files after changing `src/`. Use `npm pack --dr
y-run` to inspect the npm release contents. The build is self-contained and does not need a Harness
t the npm release contents. The build is self-contained and does not need a Harness source checkout.
